request.prompt: A hunched goblin with a sword in his right hand does a one-handed slash. From a ready stance, sword low across his belly, he lifts the sword up across his chest to his left shoulder, turning his torso left, then cuts fast diagonally down across his body to his right, arm ending extended out to the right, then returns to the ready stance. Feet stay planted.

revisions.summary: Re-authored all clips after viewer review: hands clear of the body, walk arms re-posed with level clavicles, forehand attack, perpendicular blade grip, continuous forearm twist, sword drops on death; per-frame pose audit passes (one 101-degree twist at attack wind-up).
Hand chains refit to the mesh, sword seated in the fist, arm weight bleed and pauldron poke-through fixed, upper-arm roll limited, attack rebuilt from native gobata a-f.
Fingers subdivided, grip solved per finger, claw paint limited to tips, Corsair-style scimitar with swatch texturing.
Palm sockets at the palm, left-palm-only cast glow, Meshy rig job walk/run relayered onto the fitted rig (Walking, Running).
